channel.title: Visual tools on PiHuW
channel.description: Recent content in Visual tools on PiHuW

item.title: acc-tab
item.description: A single collapsible panel inside an accordion. Must be a direct child of the accordion shortcode.

item.title: accordion
item.description: Collapsible content panels. Nest acc-tab shortcodes inside.

item.title: banner
item.description: Full-width announcement or call-to-action strip with heading and text.

item.title: block
item.description: Generic content block with media and text in a configurable side-by-side or stacked layout.

item.title: blog
item.description: Lists recent blog posts site-wide with summaries, reading time, and featured images.

item.title: caption
item.description: Adds a labelled text caption beneath an image or media element.

item.title: children
item.description: Lists the direct child pages of the current section as linked items.

item.title: cover
item.description: Full-bleed hero image with overlaid heading, text, and optional link.

item.title: feature
item.description: A single feature highlight with icon, heading, and descriptive text. Use inside feature-group for grids.

item.title: feature-group
item.description: Responsive grid container for multiple feature shortcodes.

item.title: gallery
item.description: Responsive image grid with thumbnail links to full-size images.

item.title: graph
item.description: Chart.js data visualisation. Supports line, bar, scatter, and area chart types.

item.title: image
item.description: Responsive image with optional caption, link, and Hugo image processing.

item.title: include
item.description: Includes the rendered content of another page or markdown file inline.

item.title: item
item.description: A single content card with media on one side and heading, tags, and description on the other.

item.title: item-group
item.description: Paginated list of item cards from a caller-supplied page collection. Usually called via a wrapper such as item-group-blog.

item.title: item-group-blog
item.description: Lists recent blog posts site-wide as item cards, newest first. Filters by type = “blog” automatically.

item.title: item-include
item.description: Renders a named page as an item card, pulling title, summary, and featured image from its frontmatter.

item.title: item-socials
item.description: Social media profile links displayed as icon badges.

item.title: md-param
item.description: Renders a frontmatter parameter value as inline markdown within the page content.

item.title: media
item.description: Unified media handler for images, SVGs, animated GIFs, and videos from a single shortcode.

item.title: slideshow
item.description: Auto-advancing image carousel with a configurable interval and transition.

item.title: slideshow-static
item.description: Image slideshow with manual next and previous navigation, no auto-advance.

item.title: smschat
item.description: Displays a styled SMS conversation thread with sent and received message bubbles.

item.title: table
item.description: Table wrapper. Nest thead, tbody, and tfoot shortcodes inside to build a structured table.

item.title: tbody
item.description: Table body row group. Use inside a table shortcode, wrapping tr rows.

item.title: td
item.description: Table data cell. Use inside a tr shortcode.

item.title: tfoot
item.description: Table footer row group. Use inside a table shortcode, wrapping tr rows.

item.title: th
item.description: Table header cell. Use inside a tr shortcode in a thead section.

item.title: thead
item.description: Table header row group. Use inside a table shortcode, wrapping tr rows.

item.title: tr
item.description: Table row. Use inside thead, tbody, or tfoot. Nest th or td cells inside.

item.title: trtd
item.description: Convenience shortcode that creates a complete table row of data cells from a single call.

item.title: trth
item.description: Convenience shortcode that creates a complete table row of header cells from a single call.

item.title: video
item.description: Embedded video player with optional poster image and caption.
